title: CHASE COLEMAN'S TIGER GLOBAL JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO – Nov 18
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Tiger Global just made Nvidia  
(\[NVDA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/))) its top holding, bought  
Ferrari (\[RACE\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/RACE/)](https://tickeron.com/ticker/RACE/))), and almost wiped  
out Spotify (\[SPOT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPOT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPOT/))) — what do you  
make of the Q3 13F?  
  
Tickeron AI dug through Chase Coleman's latest Tiger Global 13F and  
found a few surprises. Nvidia  
\[NVDA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/)) is now the $2.74B top  
holding after they added 7.15%, and they opened a fresh $237M Ferrari  
\[RACE\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/RACE/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/RACE/)) stake. They almost wiped out  
Spotify \[SPOT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPOT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPOT/)), cutting it 99.78%,  
while adding 48.26% to Cerebras  
\[CBRS\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CBRS/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CBRS/)) and 178.25% to Danaher  
\[DHR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/DHR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/DHR/)). On the other side, they  
slashed Alphabet \[GOOGL\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/)) by  
42.31%, TSMC \[TSM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/)) by 35.79% and Sea  
\[SE\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SE/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SE/)) by 43.41%.  
  
This is everything they owned as of the end of Q3:  
  
\- $2.74B of Nvidia \[NVDA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/)) (added 7.15%)

\- $1.63B of Meta \[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/)) (cut 20.36%)  
\- $1.43B of TSMC \[TSM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/)) (cut 35.79%)  
\- $1.16B of Microsoft \[MSFT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/))

Sold out: Chime \[CHYM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CHYM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CHYM/)), Applied  
Digital \[APLD\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/APLD/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/APLD/)), Cipher Digital  
\[CIFR\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CIFR/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CIFR/)) and Core Scientific  
\[CORZ\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CORZ/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CORZ/)). They also cut Spotify  
\[SPOT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPOT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPOT/)) by 99.78%, leaving about  
$1M.  
  
Holdings as of Sep 30, 2026, per the Q3 13F filing. 13Fs cover long  
U.S.-listed positions only and lag the market — funds may have changed  
these since then. Tiger Global reported 45 positions worth $20.2B.  
  
Curious what stands out to people here — the new Ferrari stake, Nvidia  
as the top holding, or that 99.78% cut to Spotify?  
  
This is not financial advice. 13Fs are delayed snapshots of long  
U.S.-listed positions only.
